title: Psionic program: some assets are abductees

tellings.quote: In fact I was told we know for a fact >> that some of our assets are abductees.

plain: A man named Tim Alberino says he was told that a programme studying psychic abilities knew "for a fact" that some of its own people were abductees, meaning people who say they were taken by non-human beings. Alberino repeats this as something said to him directly. If true, it would mean the people running such work believed abductions were real and were using those who had been through them.
